Context: This update covers Ethnic Wear revenue, May versus April. Revenue was INR 104520.77 in April and INR 185107.61 in May.
Insight (fact): Ethnic Wear revenue changed by 77.1% month on month, an overall increase.
Implication (hypothesis, not proven by this data alone): the movement may reflect a change in reseller activity or product mix. Recommended next step: check whether the rise in Ethnic Wear came from a few resellers or many, and confirm stock availability and return rates for Ethnic Wear before May demand carries forward.

Context: This update covers Western Wear revenue, May versus April. Revenue was INR 113866.15 in April and INR 86998.18 in May.
Insight (fact): Western Wear revenue changed by -23.6% month on month, an overall decline.
Implication (hypothesis, not proven by this data alone): the movement may reflect a change in reseller activity or product mix. Recommended next step: check whether resellers reduced their Western Wear listings or whether Western Wear demand fell, and compare order counts and return rates for Western Wear between April and May.
